links.outcome: CAD-RADS category assignment accuracy with structured few-shot prompt versus zero-shot prompt
links.effect: Zero-shot accuracy 14% (ChatGPT) and 8% (DeepSeek); few-shot improved to 98% and 93% (both P<0.001).
links.quote: Few-shot prompting significantly improved accuracy to 98% for ChatGPT and 93% for DeepSeek (both P <0.001) and eliminated hallucinations.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of few-shot classifications across repeated runs on 50 reports
links.effect: Kappa 0.957 (0.900, 1.000) for ChatGPT and 0.873 (0.779, 0.967) for DeepSeek between repeated assignments.
links.quote: Reproducibility analysis yielded kappa values of 0.957 (0.900, 1.000) ( P <0.001) for ChatGPT and 0.873 [0.779, 0.967] ( P <0.001) for DeepSeek, indicating almost perfect and strong agreement between repeated assignments, respectively, with no significant difference between the models ( P =0.125).
